WITH patient_averages AS (
    SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.ALB) AS avg_alb, AVG(1.0 * l.UN / NULLIF(l.`T-BIL`, 0)) AS avg_un_tbil_ratio
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
    GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX
), sex_averages AS (
    SELECT SEX, AVG(avg_alb) AS avg_alb, AVG(avg_un_tbil_ratio) AS avg_un_tbil_ratio
    FROM patient_averages
    GROUP BY SEX
)
SELECT SEX, avg_alb, avg_un_tbil_ratio,
       avg_alb - AVG(avg_alb) OVER () AS alb_above_mean
FROM sex_averages
WHERE avg_alb > AVG(avg_alb) OVER ()
